    github:
        Update to melting configs. (#7)

        * Snow melting configs

        - Added a server config to chance the snow melting chance per subseason. Default values should match the current behaviour.

        - Melt chance is now calculated in RandomUpdateHandler#onWorldTick rather than in RandomUpdateHandler#meltInChunk and passes in the melt chance, if for some reason a user wants snow to melt during winter.

        - Did a very inconsequential optimisation to RandomUpdateHandler#meltInChunk which was checking biome temp twice.

        * Added config for the number of "rolls" a snow/ice melt attempt will do.

        * Melt rolls config is now also per-season.
